messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Monday or Friday, giving you a three‑day weekend).  
*(Dates shown are the holiday itself; the long weekend includes the adjacent weekend days.)*

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Family Day** (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.) | Monday, Feb 20 | Feb 18–20 |
| **Good Friday** (statutory holiday in most provinces) | Friday, Apr 7 | Apr 7–9 |
| **Victoria Day** (federal holiday) | Monday, May 22 | May 20–22 |
| **Labour Day** (federal holiday) | Monday, Sep 4 | Sep 2–4 |
| **Thanksgiving** (federal holiday) | Monday, Oct 9 | Oct 7–9 |
| **Christmas Day** (federal holiday) | Monday, Dec 25 | Dec 23–25 |

> **Notes**  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.).  
> • If you’re planning trips in provinces that observe Family Day, remember it’s only a statutory holiday in certain provinces.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
